d:
The Lakers defeated the Pistons, 121-116 tonight in Detroit. Austin Reaves contributed a team-high 43 points to go with 5 rebounds 4 assists and 4 three pointers, with Collin Sexton of the Lakers adding an additional 17 points (5-10 FG) in the game. Daniss Jenkins finished with a team-high 31 points along with 8 three pointers for the Pistons in the losing effort. The Lakers improve their record to 9-2 with the win, while the Pistons fall to 6-3 for the season.
